name: event_id
description: UUID assigned when the event is written to Postgres's warehouse_outbox. The *_dedup views keep one row per event_id.

name: event_ts
description: When the event happened in the control plane (UTC). Day partitions use this column.

name: step_index
description: Zero-based position of the checkpoint within the run.

name: tool_name
description: Tool requested in this step, when step_kind is tool_call.

name: status
description: completed, refused (policy gate), failed or skipped_on_resume.

name: refusal_reason
description: Why the policy gate refused the call, e.g. tool_not_in_grant (TM-02).

name: input_hash
description: SHA-256 of the step input, as checkpointed. Replay compares these.

name: output_hash
description: SHA-256 of the step output; null if the step did not complete.

name: user_id
description: Postern account ID (UUID). Never an email or a name.

name: connection_id
description: ID of the connection (one connected Supabase project) the event concerns.
